So, Wg=mg×x×cos90°-θ=mgxsinθ

⇒WN=Nxcos90°=0
Work done by the variable force is given as W=∫x1x2Fdx.
So, Wf=∫0xfkdx=-∫0x23xmgcosθ dx

⇒Wf=-mgcosθx22×23=-mgcosθx23

By work-energy theorem

Wg+WN+Wf=∆K.E.
mgxsinθ+0-mgcosθ x23=0
⇒x=3tanθ=3tan30°=3 m
